correctness.rationale: For arbitrary abelian A, direct group multiplication gives (epsilon,a)*(delta,b)=(epsilon,(-1)^delta a+2 epsilon b). The proposed reflection relation modulo 4A is compatible with right division as well as multiplication; rotations remain singletons. The complete four-variable medial defect equals 2 epsilon[(s_gamma-s_delta)b+(s_delta-s_beta)c+2(gamma-beta)d] and hence vanishes on rotations and belongs to 4A on reflections. The input (F_b,R_a,F_0,R_0) forces F_{-b-2a}=F_{-b+2a} in every medial quotient, hence all reflection differences 4A, proving minimality without finiteness assumptions. A standalone exhaustive check independently reconstructs semidirect group conjugation and the least medial congruence in twelve finite abelian groups and returns VERIFY_OK; finite checks are supplementary only.

value.rationale: The least medial quotient is a natural universal-algebra invariant, not an arbitrary small slice. The theorem solves it for a full infinite family and arbitrary abelian rotation kernels, gives exact quotient operations and counting formulas, and exhibits a separation from the group-theoretic class-two quotient: individual rotations survive even when group gamma_3 collapses them. It extends the recent S3 example and strengthens available general lower bounds with an explicit universal description. The 4A obstruction is forced by a single natural four-variable medial relation; the result does not rely on numerical novelty alone.
